[|AI|]: Some important factors to consider when choosing workout gear for physical activity under the principles of health at every size (HAES) are:

1. Comfort: Choose clothes that fit comfortably and allow you to move freely without any restriction. Look for materials that are stretchy, moisture-wicking, and breathable to keep you cool and dry.

2. Support: In case of high-impact activities, like running or jumping, invest in sports bras that fit well and provide ample support to your chest. This will keep you comfortable and protect you from any injuries.

3. Functionality: Depending on the type of activity you prefer, choose clothing and shoes that are appropriate and functional for that particular sport. For instance, if you are swimming, go for a swimsuit that fits snugly and does not ride up or shift around. If you’re doing yoga, choose clothes that are stretchy and allow you to move freely, without any slipping or riding up.

4. Fashion: Choose workout clothes that make you feel good about yourself and represent your personal style. This will boost your confidence and motivate you to exercise consistently.

5. Affordability: Workout clothes can be expensive, so look for good deals or discounts that fit your budget without compromising on quality. Shop around and compare prices before you buy anything.

Remember, physical activity is about being healthy and happy, not about fitting into a certain size or shape. Choose workout gear that makes you feel good about yourself and supports your journey towards a healthier and happier lifestyle!
